first_proof.decision_rule: Block UI integration if counts, rename/merge policy or shallow-history completeness cannot be explained.

milestones.title: File histories produce correct, inspectable counts
milestones.outcome: History counts reconcile with real Git under explicit traversal and completeness rules.
milestones.proof: Saved-output plus real temporary Git cases: merges, renames, bulk changes, unusual paths, shallow and missing history.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: History counts reconcile with real Git under explicit traversal and completeness rules. Existing source-only scanning remains usable.
milestones.rollback: Revert the scoped milestone commit or omit optional evidence; no stored-data migration.

milestones.title: Activity changes justified review priorities
milestones.outcome: An optional view adds useful prioritization in two pilot repositories or is rejected.
milestones.proof: Ten manually verified histories per repository; source-only versus activity-assisted decision review and runtime accounting.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: An optional view adds useful prioritization in two pilot repositories or is rejected. Existing source-only scanning remains usable.
milestones.rollback: Revert the scoped milestone commit or omit optional evidence; no stored-data migration.

cut_line: Function archaeology, remote fetch, author scores and ticket integration.
Co-change until frequency earns its cost. A later proof must show a hidden peer, an expected test pair, and a bulk-change false positive.
Universal churn thresholds or a combined health score.
